title: Do not blame a child campaign when a variation-family retail change better explains the conversion break
scenario: A child-ASIN campaign keeps similar traffic and CPC but loses conversion immediately after a variation-family restructure and sibling retail change. The request asks whether bids should be cut because child-level ACOS worsened.

retail_timeline.detail: the advertised child was moved into a restructured variation family
a close substitute sibling became materially cheaper during the decline window
purchased-ASIN mix shifted toward the promoted sibling while family-level demand stayed approximately stable

forbidden_behaviors: Recommend an aggressive bid cut solely because the advertised child's ACOS or CVR worsened.
Ignore the dated variation-family restructure, sibling price event, and purchased-ASIN crossover because the advertised child itself remained active.
Describe the child conversion decline as confirmed advertising inefficiency when campaign controls and traffic are stable.
Treat child-level attributed sales movement as equivalent to parent-family demand loss.
required_observations: Traffic, CPC, and core ad controls are broadly stable while conversion breaks on the same date as family-level retail changes.
Parent/child structure and sibling retail conditions are plausible upstream causes of the child-level conversion shift.
Family-level orders are approximately stable while demand/purchased-ASIN mix moves toward a sibling, which is consistent with substitution or retail mix shift rather than simple traffic waste.
Recovery should prioritize retail/family diagnosis or scoped observation before suppressing qualified advertising traffic.

rubric.requirement: Check dated parent/variation and sibling retail changes before blaming advertising.
Compare child and family-level outcomes when substitution or purchased-ASIN crossover is plausible.
Prefer the retail/family explanation over unsupported bid inefficiency when timing and mechanism align.
Hold or downgrade aggressive traffic suppression until the family-level retail cause is resolved or rejected.
